create.name: Under The Light Yoga School
create.bio:
Under The Light Yoga School, known as UTL, opened in 2006 in Yoyogi, Tokyo, and has kept a single studio there ever since rather than growing into a chain. Its name, meaning "under the lamp", comes from the founders' picture of someone meditating by lamplight, and the school describes yoga as a set of methods handed down from ancient times that work on the mind as well as the body. Its faculty includes teachers certified in the Ashtanga, Sivananda, Iyengar and Dharma Yoga lineages.

UTL is best known in Japan as a teacher-training school. Its Yoga Alliance-registered 200-hour course is built from three levels of teacher training plus short modules on anatomy, asana and adjustment, taken in person on weekends, part-time or partly by recorded video, and a modular 300-hour advanced course leads to the 500-hour level. The advanced study includes close readings of the Yoga Sutras, the Upanishads, the Gheranda Samhita and the Bhagavad Gita, alongside classical Hatha, breath and meditation teaching. The Yoyogi studio runs public classes through the week, with an English-taught class on Thursday evenings, and UTL Yoga Online streams live and recorded classes. Most teaching is in Japanese.

courses.title: RYT200 Yoga Teacher Training (Yoga Alliance 200-hour)
courses.description: UTL's 200-hour course combines three teacher-training levels (TT1 to TT3) with short modules on anatomy, asana and hands-on adjustment. It can be taken as one six-month weekend course in the Yoyogi studio, module by module over up to eighteen months, or partly by recorded video. Taught in Japanese; the price shown is for the all-in-one in-person plan.

courses.title: RYT500 Advanced Yoga Teacher Training (300-hour)
courses.description: A modular 300-hour course for graduates of a 200-hour training, taken in the studio, online or both, either as a set eight-month programme or at the student's own pace. Modules include readings of the Upanishads, the Gheranda Samhita and the Yoga Sutras, classical Hatha teaching, breath and meditation, and supervised practice teaching. The price shown is the published regular price for the all-in-one course.

courses.title: Studio classes in Yoyogi (drop-in)
courses.description: Public classes at the Yoyogi studio, graded by experience and by physical intensity, with one class a week taught in English on Thursday evenings. Booking ahead through the school's reservation system is required; six-class packs need a membership.

courses.title: UTL Yoga Online
courses.description: The school's streaming service, with more than sixty live classes a week and a recorded library, including early-morning flow and a daily meditation and breathing class. Monthly talks cover topics such as the Bhagavad Gita and Buddhist meditation. Plans run from a live-only tier to full access.
